Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check. An entry that stops

Matching is per (file, term). Use term '*' only with a strong reason.

allow.reason: The open-core boundary needs a public rationale, and LICENSING.md depends on it. Keeping an accepted ADR intact is also better practice than editing the record to satisfy a linter. Note the ADR itself rules pricing/packaging/tiers out of this repo — this entry covers the reasoning for the boundary, not any pricing detail. Decided 2026-08-07.
Gemini's API free tier exhausting its daily quota — a model-provider limit that changed a recipe's driver. Engineering, not our commercial model.
Groq and Ollama provider tiers in a model-selection table. Describes what a user's chosen provider costs them, not what we charge.
A PagerDuty sandbox account used for connector testing.
A single row marking a custom registry / ratings / monetization milestone as NOT on the roadmap horizon. Records an exclusion; contains no strategy.
